decisions.reason: Because this condenser remains close to the core portfolio and the firm has now publicly carried it for two cycles, sunk development and market-commitment effects favor continuing unless clear failure becomes undeniable.

Management is likely to keep this condenser as well, since it fits the announced direction in efficient thermal equipment and the accumulated commitment makes reversal harder without strong negative evidence.
This tube liner reinforces the firm's lifecycle-service business and installed-base logic, so its strategic fit and relatively defensible niche make withdrawal unlikely.
As a customized product line with several models, it represents a visible and broader commitment to core customer applications that management would be especially reluctant to unwind.
These repair inserts build directly on service capabilities and customer relationships, and management can readily justify keeping them as part of the firm's reliability and maintenance offering.
